summaryZh: Mooshagian Lab 研究感觉信息如何驱动运动行为，重点是视觉空间信息如何指导并协调眼和手臂运动，以及顶叶皮层如何参与伸手动作相关的决策。
researchQuestions: 视觉空间信息如何指导并协调眼和手臂运动？
顶叶皮层如何参与伸手动作相关决策？
topics: 视觉空间信息与眼臂协调

evidence.quote: I am a research scientist in the Cognitive Science Department at UCSD. My lab studies how sensory information is used to drive motor behavior.

We primarily try to understand how visuopspatial information is used to guide and coordinate eye and arm movements. These days we are focusing on the contribution of parietal cortex to decision making related to reaching.
